cells.rationale: The 10-year yield is hovering just below 5% (4.99% on Oct 27) after a three-week decline from above 5.3%. The downward trend and lack of a clear catalyst for a sharp reversal make a move above 5% by Oct 30 less likely, though the FOMC decision and data releases this week could trigger a surprise. With a typical 3-day standard deviation of 10–15 bp, the outcome is close to even but slightly favors staying below 5%.

note: Judge panel member forecasting from Claude's evidence brief before each cutoff; scored as a separate method.
